0.original: Gegeroon of Memeroon's Trading Post has deliveries that need to be made.

1.original: Gegeroon of Memeroon's Trading Post has a delivery to make, but not enough time to do it himself. Help him out and deliver a hot box lunch to Tanga Tonga in his cabin at Thalaos.

2.original: Tanga Tonga is immensely pleased to receive his little bag full of toast and egg products. Fully sated, he can now focus on his research.

24.original: Deliver the hot box lunch to Tanga Tonga.

48.original: Gegeroon has good goods. Good goods need delivery. But Gegeroon busy. Too, too busy.

49.original: Have hot box lunch. Qiqirn hot box lunch. Lunch for Tanga Tonga. Tanga Tonga in Thalaos. You take for Gegeroon!

50.original: Leave me be. I'm too hungry to continue my research, let alone receive visitors.

51.original: This... This is a Qiqirn hot box lunch from Memeroon's Trading Post! H-How did you...? Thank you, friend! At last, I will be able to hear myself think over the growling of my stomach.

52.original: I was so eager to come study the fossils, I never gave any thought to how I'd take my meals. I've neither the time nor the materials to cook on my own, so the trading post has been a godssend. I'm always happy to be on the receiving end of a nice, hot box lunch!
